title: CLAUDE FORGETS EVERYTHING. THESE TWO FIX IT
description:
Most people don't know that you can fix claudes memory with just 2 skills
The first is research-skill. It gives Claude a persistent research memory scoped to your project, so findings survive even when the context gets wiped.
The second is claude-deep-research-skill. It turns Claude into a proper deep research agent you clone straight into your skills folder.
Together, your agent stops starting from zero every morning.
Research it did in March is still there in July.
Both free on GitHub.
Comment 'yam' and I'll send you both links.
